notes: Hides specific videos. `videoIds` = manual overrides (add an ID to permanently hide it; G4dabBG3iUc = a NASCAR promo at the San Diego Zoo, not an animal video). `autoBlockThreshold` = when a video reaches this many viewer reports, the daily build moves it into `autoBlocked` (managed automatically; 0 disables). `autoBlocked` entries are added by the build with {id,title,reports,addedAt} — to un-hide one, delete it from that list.
